coverage.note: All 67 VBM and all 67 early-voting county originals have October 25, 2026 portal uploads and reconcile to the 8:06 AM official compilation. No prior voter records substituted. Escambia and Manatee resume after missing October 24 reports; daily district changes are withheld for their districts. Eighteen counties newly report early voting after opening October 24. Unchanged source-file hashes are recorded separately from reporting timestamps. Sarasota retains 26 early records dated October 12; preserved as reported. One Broward DEM voter appears in both source methods; combined statewide and affected district participation counts include that voter once. October 24 daily baselines are rebuilt from EVL originals only; prior exported FL-27/FL-28 early totals included 10/12 VBM status E records and are corrected here.

definitions.provided: VoteByMail status P (provided, not yet returned).
definitions.returnRate: Returned divided by sent/provided universe (V ÷ (P + V)).
definitions.early: Reported early in-person ballots from separate EVL county originals
definitions.cast: Unique recorded voters across returned VBM and early voting; same-person cross-method records counted once. Reported method counts remain unadjusted and reconcile to official sources.
